description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier HTML module for handling form-related elements in HTML 4, including classes and methods for setting up form elements and their attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Forms
classes.description: Class representing the XHTML 1.1 Forms module, defining form-related HTML elements and their configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes form-related elements and attributes within the module, configuring elements like form, input, select, option, textarea, button, fieldset, label, legend, and optgroup.
